## Summary
The Phase-15 **Astro static-first (zero-JS-by-default) web shell**, and the **epistemic visual language** every later Phase-15 surface (P15.2–P15.5) consumes. Implements `docs/tickets/P15.1__web-shell.md` (canonical §§39.0, 39.1, 39.9, 40). Confined to `web/` (SIG-ENG-010); the read API / exports it renders from are P14.1 / P14.2 (already merged).

This ticket **owns the shared visual language + the a11y / no-JS / archivability baseline** — later surfaces reference these components, they do not redefine them (any change is an ADR, not an ad-hoc edit).

## What changed
- **`web/src/lib/`** — the visual language as pure, colour-free logic: `epistemic.ts` (four §10.7 fields, four-step glyph, four §9.5 absence kinds, contested predicate, contradiction range), `fixtures.ts` (a faithful subset of the read-API envelope + a `FactView` view-model), `task.ts` (absence → `GENERATED` research task via a base64url no-JS route), `citation.ts` (belief-pinned permalinks).
- **`web/src/components/`** — `SupportGlyph`, `EpistemicFields`, `ContestedMarker`, `AbsenceHatch`, `ContradictionRange`, `Citation`.
- **`web/src/pages/`** — landing, the visual-language reference, the reference map (+ tabular equivalent) and graph (+ list equivalent), and the pre-generated task-intake route.
- **`web/src/styles/epistemic.css`** — design tokens; every `--sig-epi-*` is an `hsl()` outside the green band.
- **CI** — a new `web` job runs axe WCAG 2.2 AA, the OSI-only dependency-licence gate, and Lighthouse performance budgets.
- **Docs** — ADR-049; traceability P15.1; risk register Phase 15 (RISK-P15-01..08); ADR index (adds 048 + 049).

## Design decisions (see ADR-049)
- **Zero client JS by construction**: no `client:*` directive anywhere ⇒ `dist` has 0 `.js` files; the Lighthouse `script:size` budget is 0. Archivability is structural.
- **Green never for epistemic state** is enforced by a stylesheet-parsing test *and* a rendered-hue browser check.
- **Absence → research task with no JavaScript**: the hatch is a GET link to a `getStaticPaths`-generated page; params travel in a URL/filesystem-safe base64url slug.
- **Committed fixtures, not a live API at build** (static-first); the envelope type is a faithful subset of `api/src/api/models.py`, so wiring to `/v1` is a data-source swap.
- **Deviation**: the licence gate is "OSI-approved **or** a short documented waiver" (`CC0-1.0`, `BlueOak-1.0.0` in the toolchain tree — neither is CC-BY-NC / source-available / BUSL), never mislabelling them as OSI.

## Verification
- `npm run test:unit` → **25 pass** (epistemic / task / citation / design-token invariants).
- `npm run test:e2e` → **26 pass**: axe WCAG 2.2 AA (0 violations, every page), render-path assertions, and a **JS-disabled** project proving the no-JS baseline.
- `npm run check:licenses` → 197 prod deps OSI/waived; `npm run check:perf` → perf ≥ 0.9, script bytes = 0, total ≤ 150 KB.
- Live `astro preview` inspection: 0 `<script>` tags; 3-row map table; base64url task page renders `data-task-status="generated"`.

## Acceptance criteria → evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Core usable without JS; map tabular + graph list equivalents | `tests/e2e/content.nojs.spec.ts` (JS disabled): 3-row table, 2-edge list |
| WCAG 2.2 AA passes; no colour-only | `tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts` axe (wcag2a/2aa/21aa/22aa) 0 violations; `design-tokens.test.ts` + rendered no-green check |
| Four fields independently visible; no fused badge | `shell.spec.ts` "four separate field chips and never a fused badge" |
| Absence one texture, clickable, task end-to-end | `shell.spec.ts` "absence hatch → research task, end to end"; `content.nojs.spec.ts` |
| Contested marked at every appearance | `shell.spec.ts` "contested marker is persistent across render paths" (detail/popup/list/SVG) |
| Belief-pinned permalink + citation every page; reproducible after correction | `citation.test.ts` "reproducible after a correction"; every-page e2e citation check |
| Phase-gate: CI green, tests, ADR, traceability, risk register | new `web` CI job; ADR-049; traceability P15.1; RISK-P15-01..08 |
